summary: Addresses the 'no Will only/not attach to X enforcement' gap (issue #156), per the user's detailed spec. New CardDefinition fields AttachRequiresKeyword/AttachExcludesKeyword/AttachRequiresName, enforced by shared KeywordOrHuman/AttachmentLegalTarget helpers used identically by Equip()'s Require checks and the offered legal-targets filter in MatchQueries.cs (previously duplicated logic, now one source of truth). New CardPersonalHonor(card) (Dishonorable fixes it at 0; a persistent modifier like a token still applies once honorable) replaces raw printed-PersonalHonor reads for the Follower Honor Requirement and three other comparisons sharing the same current-not-printed semantics (lobby, lower-or-equal-honor-than-performer, personality-lower-honor-than-self) -- fixing a latent bug never previously exercised, with no test regression. Deliberately left unchanged: Proclaim's Honor grant and the Dishonorable-death penalty, both established rules that key off the printed value regardless of current status. Also wired into equip-battle's Spell-attach validation. Shared-file note: all changed files are within L5R.Core (rules engine) and its test suite, plus docs/ROADMAP.md -- a single rules-lane primitive change; no UI/client files touched.
validation: New AttachmentRestrictions test (5 scenarios): keyword-required + Honor Requirement together (Asahina House Guard's shape, checked both at Accept and in the offered legal-targets list), Dishonorable zeroing current Personal Honor despite a high printed value, a Personal-Honor-boosting token compensating for a low printed value, keyword-excluded, the Human/Nonhuman special case, and a named-Personality restriction. Full suite: 97/97 core + 34/34 published + 8/8 deck format pass. bash tools/check.sh --skip-client passes.
remaining: Cost modifications tied to a named-Personality restriction (paying less Gold, ignoring costs) are a separate Equip-time discount mechanism, not built here -- noted in issue #156 for whenever a card needs it.
